mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by hepatic CYP450 enzymes (CYP3A4 primary); praziquantel may inhibit trazodone metabolism, increasing trazodone plasma concentrations and CNS effects.
action: Monitor for increased trazodone adverse effects (sedation, dizziness, orthostatic hypotension); consider dose reduction of trazodone if CNS symptoms emerge during concurrent use.
